We refer to this automatically-collected information as "Device Information." We collect Device Information using the following technologies: "Cookies" are data files that are placed on your device or computer and often include an anonymous unique identifier. We leverage cookies to create a login session for you to utilize our Services. "Log files" track actions occurring with our Services, and collect data including your IP address, browser type, device type, referring/exit pages, and date/time stamps. "Web beacons," "tags," and "pixels" are electronic files used to record information about how you browse our Services. Additionally, in order to utilize the Services, we require certain information from you, which includes: Your name Your email address Your phone number We refer to this as "Required Service Information." Separately, the Services can be optimized by providing additional information, including: Your location to prevent fraudulent transactions and to accurately classify business-trip expenses Your calendar to properly associate meetings with your expense data Your contacts to properly classify expense data Images and files you choose to upload, such as expense receipts or a profile image Your bank account information We refer to this as "Requested Service Information." Where you participate in a card or prepaid program that requires identity verification, we also collect government-issued photo ID images and related identification numbers, and in-session liveness / biometric face-match media and outcomes — including live selfie or video images and facial-geometry templates / 3D face maps (together, "KYC Information"), typically via our identity-verification provider, Sumsub (Sum and Substance Ltd.). When we talk about "Personal Information" in this Privacy Policy, we are talking about Device Information, Required Service Information, Requested Service Information, and KYC Information. How Do We Use Your Personal Information? We use the Device Information that we collect to help us screen for potential risk and fraud (in particular, your IP address), and more generally to improve and optimize our Services (for example, by generating analytics about how our customers browse and interact with our Services).
